pr_title: github-pull-request-make: stress all directly tests in CI
pr_body:
Previously, we only stressed new and unskipped tests in CI. With this patch, all directly modified tests will be stressed in CI, except for tests that match the following regex's: "^TestDataDriven$","^TestLogic_".

Fixes #108046

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/108389)
@rickystewart since you approved, I didn't bother modifying `gitDiff`. I'll bors this once this is green and send out a message to dbengineering about the change.

issue_context.title: github-pull-request-make: add modified tests to stress CI target
issue_context.body:
Currently,  we only stress new tests and unskipped tests in a given PR. To prevent merging flakey tests, we ought to stress all modified go tests in a PR as well. 

This should be easy to implement: we currently find all new and skipped tests by[ parsing](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/d9375ac5b8c6ddaf3a03806d459cee87d76cd41d/pkg/cmd/github-pull-request-make/main.go#L115) the PR diff, which contains the test name of every directly modified test. 

By relying on the pr diff, we cannot target indirectly modified tests. For example, if a pr modifies a helper function called by several unit tests, the pr diff will not contain these unit tests. This seems fine: if a pr modified the function `testcluster.StartTestCluster()` for example, I wouldn't want to stress all the tests that call `StartTestCluster`.

Targeting modified or new data driven tests is out of scope for this issue. Further, I don't think we should stress any `TestDataDriven()` unit tests, as they have many subtests that are better stressed via the solution to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/108055

Jira issue: CRDB-30299
